scope: Exposed development. Virtual task/replacement utility, actual semantic custody/history and supported search-entry controls; no price fitting, default change, human holdout, universal optimum or strength claim.

declaration.question: Does adding an actual active opponent to the same two-victim virtual law change attainable capture reward versus surviving service, and how much is action-order dependent?
declaration.design: Exact4x4 ordered distinct actor/active-enemy/stationary-enemy contexts, Q/R/B/N both actor and active enemy. One action each, actor-first and opponent-first minimax. Unit ordinary token capture gain/loss, no prices, anchors or promotions; inactive victim cannot move. Open board with real ray blocking/removal and actor loss absorbing. Uniform ordered roots/active modes is an explicit virtual context law, not game or equilibrium distribution.
declaration.selection: All3360ordered roots per actor/opponent mode,16mode pairs. Before labels or scores. Candidate/root tie moves smallest square, no tuning.
declaration.decision: Quantify same-scope gross/net/survival and first/second action order. If shared one-contact scaling misses these differences, construct joint reward/loss continuation rather than retune discount. No output becomes material/default without separate law/mechanism evidence.
declaration.cost: First4x4 exact census bounded one process, stop flags per actor block,5min checkpoint; if unfinished preserve partial and estimate remaining cost before extension. Independent direct enumeration and actual Core controls follow, no new workers.
declaration.limitations: No equal-inventory reachable game, no WDL/amateur-strength claim, no victim replenishment. Zero/negative signed rewards are not normalized as positive prices.

archive_read.finding: Tag semantics validated specific castling/EP/promotion/drop/capture, not a fitted continuation law. Retain physical base/current and absorbing owner loss; do not restore archived module or gate.

oracle8.scope: 256 prespecified deterministic contexts per16mode pairs, not full8x8 independent oracle

declaration.question: How concentrated/context-dependent is matched replacement reward, and does a nested-action consistency claim hold?
declaration.design: Reuse exact4x4 context law and two action orders. Compare Q-R (nested action sets) and B-N (not nested), same source/activeenemy/victim/opponent type. No removal, price fitting, phase tuning or label access.
declaration.decision: Q-R negative root differences indicate implementation error under this exact equal-payoff nested-action law. B-N signed reversals demonstrate that aggregate ordering is not pointwise contribution. Strata and zeros are retained; these are relative task contributions, not price ratios.
declaration.cost: 26880 paired roots, one process, no new model/census/population. New per-context projection needed because previous census retained only aggregates.

declaration.question: Do fresh/reused native scores agree with independent full-history Core minimax?
declaration.roots: Same four preselected actual histories, same ordinal debug leaf; no native legality or TT in reference.
declaration.budget: 20000leaf evaluations/15sec checked at evaluation, per depth3/4 reference cell. These are reference fuses, not resource-matched speed comparisons.
declaration.decision: Every completed reference must equal previously retained native complete scores. Incomplete results remain unknown, no numeric parity claim.

declaration.question: Does persistent supported native search agree with fresh TT across actual capture-to-hand, downgrade and drop histories?
declaration.selection: Before search: sole J capture fromsource6; lexicographically first legal Black response leaving a legal White J drop; first legal White J drop. Four actual history roots. Search depth3/4,20000nodes/2sec/q0,1MiBTT, same ordinal leaf; reused then fresh then repeated reuse.
declaration.decision: Every result PV Core-legal. Equal completed-depth fresh/reused scores required; incomplete cells not parity evidence. No random population/strength/price claim.

declaration.question: Does one product-boundary comparison entry support a tier1 familiar-movement mixture without a new engine?
declaration.design: 6x6 two mirrored inventories: Chess R/B/eight-way N, Shogi G/S and one-step F forward movers, one K each. Front row6F, back row layout. Movement mixture only, not full Chess/Shogi special/promotion/drop rules. Equivalent quiet-anchor semantic ingress; same generic-v1 evaluation/plain and native-legality bundle.
declaration.cost: Existing entry4096nodes/5sec per search,4repeated calls/root/depth,reference4096leaf/5sec. Startup/profile separate; incomplete cells unknown.
declaration.decision: Core legal PVs and complete reference score parity; compare completed equal-depth resource observations, no strength/price tuning.

declaration.question: Can same current Gold geometry but distinct captured base create different opponent continuation service?
declaration.design: Counterfactual40-entity9x9 roots under actual Standard Shogi mechanics. Move White G from3,0 to3,3, Black R from7,7 to3,5 and Black baseP/currentTP from2,6 to1,5 (explicit promotion intervention, no doubled current pawn). Compare target G versus baseP/currentTP at3,3, otherwise same board. This replaces one base token; not asserted standard inventory/reachable history. Preserve all40 entities, no sparse reachable-game claim.
declaration.continuation: White0,2->0,3; BlackR3,5x3,3; White0,3->0,4; Black captured-base drop2,4; White1,2->1,3. Preselected before outcomes. Gold/TP initial tag move geometry compared, then exact capture reset/base hand/drop followed by next tag capture opportunity.
declaration.decision: Native/Core legal sets must agree at all actual continuation roots. Captured TP becomes P; G remains G. A distinct post-drop legal capture demonstrates custody liability not represented by same current-board contact histogram. No numeric compensation or complete price inference.
declaration.cost: 2 roots x6full-history legal-set checks; no search/label fitting.

declaration.question: Can the supported whole-native engine use the same explicit rule-derived static table as independent Core minimax?
declaration.profile: Existing generic-v1 rule-derived BOARD/HAND tables only, no dynamic terms. This is an interface/search control, not the contact prior, a hand-price law or a new default.
declaration.native: Fresh1MiB engine,20000nodes/5sec/q0, then repeat warm, same table each. Full PV Core-checked.
declaration.reference: Core exhaustive minimax, no native/TT;20000leaf/15sec checked at evaluation. References are not equal-resource speed competitors; unknown on fuse.
declaration.decision: Compare score only on completed same-depth reference/native cells, preserve all incompleteness. Label/type sorting cannot supply evaluation weights implicitly.

declaration.question: At the same declared node/time ceiling, what completed depth and ordinary score does each supported entry deliver with identical leaf tables?
declaration.conditions: Both20000nodes/5sec,q0,root tactics off, fresh TT each depth; cold/warm repeats. Static rule-derived tables pinned to previous control. Public capture ordering uses existing Evaluator.capture_order_value:10*captured-moving//10; native retains its own ordering. Earlier custom8*captured-moving is retained separately, not the standard-order comparison. No dynamic leaf terms, fitting or price selection.
declaration.decision: Record all completion/cost/PV outcomes. Compare scores only at completed equal depth and ordinary-score units; terminal units remain explicit and different. Node definitions/TT layouts differ, so report rather than call this pure language speedup.
